- [PREFERENCE] User's goal for pursuing a certification in digital marketing is to enhance their current role and potentially move into a more senior position in the future.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a comparison of the two programs, including curriculum, duration, cost, exam details, and industry recognition.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] DMCA program covers topics such as digital marketing strategy, SEO, PPC, social media marketing, email marketing, analytics, mobile marketing, and digital marketing metrics.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] DMCA program duration is typically 3-4 months with 30 hours of video lessons and 30 hours of study time.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] DMCA program cost is around $1,995 with a payment plan option.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] DMCA program culminates in a 3-hour, 180-question exam, and certification is valid for 3 years.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] CDMP program covers similar topics but is self-paced with an estimated 12-15 hours of study time.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] CDMP program cost is around $1,495 for AMA members and $1,995 for non-members.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] CDMP program concludes with a 120-question, 2-hour exam, and certification is also valid for 3 years.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Job prospects for digital marketing professionals include roles such as Digital Marketing Specialist, SEO Specialist, PPC Specialist, Social Media Manager, and Digital Marketing Manager.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Employment of marketing managers is projected to grow 6% from 2020 to 2030.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Salary ranges for digital marketing professionals with DMCA certification are approximately $45,000 - $110,000 per year.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Salary ranges for digital marketing professionals with CDMP certification are approximately $40,000 - $100,000 per year.
